# Hansen Global Forest Change (GFW / UMD)

- **Source Catalogue**: Google Earth Engine (`UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11`)
- **Citation**: Hansen, M. C., et al. "High-Resolution Global Maps of 21st-Century Forest Cover Change." Science 342 (15 November): 850–53.
- **Licence**: CC BY 4.0
- **Use**: Physical tree canopy density (`treecover2000`) and forest loss/gain detection.
- **Access Route**: Live GEE reduction or tile extract for spatial inference.
